'''Melkans''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] forces during the [[Korriban Incursion]], when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="TOR" /> in [[3637 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]]. Melkans was one four commanders who led Imperial forces in the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by Republic forces in their advance to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Melkans appears as one of the four Imperial commanders that must be killed in the Republic version of the Tactical Flashpoint "Assault on Tython," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.7: Invasion. For Imperial players, Melkans is replaced by Commander [[Alavai]], and the two share many of their game mechanics.<ref name="TOR" />
